name: SHAMAN KING
description: Medium Yoh Asakura enters a battle tournament held every 500 years, competing with other shamans in a bid to become the all-powerful Shaman King.

videos.title: The Boy Who Dances with Ghosts
videos.overview: Shaman Yoh Asakura offers to help his new classmate Manta face a notorious thug with the aid of a legendary samurai spirit.

videos.title: Another Shaman
videos.overview: Yoh and Manta encounter the shaman Ren, who shows no mercy when fighting a punk. Furious at Ren's misuse of his powers, Yoh faces him in battle.

videos.title: Anna and Tao Jun
videos.overview: Anna tells Yoh about the new tournament to crown the next Shaman King. Ren's sister Jun challenges Yoh to a battle, with Amidamaru as the prize.

videos.title: Happy Place
videos.overview: After possessing Ryu, Tokageroh takes Manta hostage. Yoh and Amidamaru fight him, but Tokageroh wields Harusame and they're at a disadvantage.

videos.title: Over Soul
videos.overview: One of the Patch Officiants, Silva, unleashes his five animal spirits against Yoh to determine if he's worthy of participating in the Shaman Fight.

videos.title: Yoh vs. Horohoro!
videos.overview: Now qualified for the tournament, Yoh faces his first opponent, Horohoro of Hokkaido, a proud Ainu shaman who can manipulate ice and snow.

videos.title: A Form of Courage
videos.overview: Faust VIII, a necromancer who can manipulate corpses, enrages Yoh when he targets Manta for sadistic experimentation before their match.

videos.title: Progress
videos.overview: With Ren as his next opponent, Yoh distances himself from Manta to ensure his friend's safety. Later, Yoh returns to Izumo to continue his training.

videos.title: Yoh vs. Ren: Again!
videos.overview: The last battle in the preliminary round begins. Fated rivals Yoh and Ren fight to the limit, but who will punch their ticket to the main tournament?

videos.title: Night in the Flame
videos.overview: Ren returns to China to take care of unfinished business. The BōZ Brothers ambush Yoh and Tamao, but a familiar face comes to their rescue.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Men
videos.overview: Back home, an imprisoned Ren vows to defeat his father after losing to him in a fight. Meanwhile, Yoh and the others set out for China to rescue Ren.

videos.title: Ren vs. En: The End of the Tao
videos.overview: Ren and his allies make their way toward En. The head of the Tao family may be a formidable foe, but Yoh and company aren't ones to back down.

videos.title: And Hao!
videos.overview: Yoh's group meets the self-proclaimed future king. Those in the main tournament board a flight, not knowing their first trial is about to begin.

videos.title: Lyserg the Avenger
videos.overview: As Yoh and the others prepare to travel to a town where a Patch Tribe village once stood, the dowser Lyserg appears and asks to join their group.

videos.title: When the Pieces Come Together
videos.overview: Yohmei tasks Anna with delivering an ancient book belonging to the Asakura family to Yoh in the United States. Horohoro's guardian Kororo goes missing.

videos.title: Enter the Ultra-Pompandour
videos.overview: Searching for answers, Yoh and company arrive at the ancestral village of the Patch Tribe, where they find themselves beset by Hao's followers.

videos.title: Guns of the Angels
videos.overview: Facing Boris, Ryu unleashes a new power acquired from his training with Yoh's grandfather Yohmei. An unexpected person appears before Manta and Anna.

videos.title: Great Spirits and My Team
videos.overview: Yoh's group reaches the Patch Tribe Village as they find the Great Spirits and learn the purpose of the Shaman Fight. A cheery shaman joins the team.

videos.title: Jaguar
videos.overview: While looking for Lyserg, Yoh and friends are confronted by Faust, who makes a startling offer. Finally the stage is set, and the Shaman Fight begins.

videos.title: Joco's Christmas
videos.overview: Team Ren faces off against Hao's lackeys, Team Tsuchi-gumi. Joco recalls his past with a certain person after being cornered in a desperate situation.

videos.title: Iron Maiden Jeanne
videos.overview: The second Shaman Fight begins as Team X-I of the X-Laws take on Egypt's Team Niles. But X-I's newest member is someone Yoh's group knows all too well.

videos.title: I'll Go Anywhere with You
videos.overview: Team Funbari Hot Springs begins their first match versus the Icemen. But Yoh vows to defeat them with one attack thanks to the ultra senji ryakketsu.

videos.title: The Power of Yoh
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by Faust's new Over Soul, the Icemen crumble under the pressure — then launch a sub-zero counterattack as the end of the match approaches.

videos.title: Trust No One
videos.overview: Yoh meets with Lyserg for a long-awaited conversation, but others lurking nearby intervene. Finally, X-Laws' team X-III takes on Hao's Hoshi-gumi team.

videos.title: The Great Onmyoji, Hao Asakura
videos.overview: Yoh watches helplessly as Team X-III desperately fights Hao, who reveals the secret of his birth and his thousand-year history with the Asakura clan.

videos.title: Mikihisa Typhoon
videos.overview: Yoh's friends are stunned by the revelation about Hao. Later, a mysterious masked man appears before Team Ren with an offer to make them stronger.

videos.title: Farewell Forever
videos.overview: Ren gains new power after taking on his powerful opponent. As the Shaman Fight continues, Hao's followers begin targeting teams outside the ring.

videos.title: Yoh's Decision
videos.overview: Horohoro and Joco try to escape Hao's follower Peyote Díaz with an injured Ren, but Yoh makes a surprising entrance. Elsewhere, Anna makes her move.

videos.title: Emeth
videos.overview: As Anna helps Mikihisa's teammates escape to their Shaman Fight, Tamao and Jun's battle against Hao's Hana-gumi heats up.

videos.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile
videos.overview: Yoh accepts Jeanne's conditions as payment for healing Ren, leaving their friends in shock. Anna recalls the first time she met Yoh five years ago.

videos.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile ||
videos.overview: Yoh tries to understand his fiancée, who continues to reject him and her connection to the demon attacking the town. Matamune's past is revealed.

videos.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile |||
videos.overview: Bit by bit, Anna and Yoh get closer when they visit the shrine together for New Year's. But Anna's powers bring on a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile IV
videos.overview: Yoh and Matamune arrive at Mt. Osorezan to rescue Anna from the giant demon born from people's hearts, but Yoh only has one shot to save her.

videos.title: To Be King
videos.overview: Yoh's path to being Shaman King is over. Ryu and Manta spy on Jeanne's successful resurrection of Ren, which has an unexpectedly powerful side effect.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Horohoro finishes the fight with Brocken's team. Lyserg brings an injured Horohoro to Yoh's team when Peyote attacks with the intent to kill.

videos.title: Redseb and Seyrarm
videos.overview: Mikihisa's teammates, siblings Ludsev and Seyram, seek revenge against the person who killed their father. But Yoh steps in before it's too late.

videos.title: Winds of Laughter
videos.overview: Golem's new user goes on a rampage while Ren, Ludsev and the others come up with a plan to bring them back to their senses. Hao gives Opacho a task.

videos.title: Graduation
videos.overview: Opacho appears in front of Yoh with a message: Yoh must return to the Shaman Fight or Hao will destroy Golem and the children. What will he decide?

videos.title: The Summit
videos.overview: Yoh's battle with X-Laws to re-enter the Shaman Fight comes to an end as Luchist Lasso and Jeanne enter the fray. Later, Yoh reveals a plan to beat Hao.

videos.title: Humility
videos.overview: As the Shaman Fight matches enter the final stages, Team Ren faces a fierce battle against The Wisdom Kings, who can nullify a person's Over Soul.

videos.title: Encounters in Hell
videos.overview: Horohoro clinches the win for Team Ren, meaning their next opponent is Team Funbari Hot Springs. Meanwhile, a dubious group approaches Yoh and others.

videos.title: A Great Trial
videos.overview: Yoh continues to fight his way through hell with his new ability. As the Shaman Fight gets more complicated, an unprecedented trial awaits Yoh's team.

videos.title: The End of a Dream
videos.overview: Marco and the others desperately resist Hao's attack to keep Jeanne safe. Hao's clash with the X-Laws causes an unexpected crisis.

videos.title: A Leisurely Chat
videos.overview: Hao's lackeys begin to doubt his intentions. Anna confronts Hao, who reveals his ultimate oversoul. Yoh's group steps into the Shaman Fight ring.

videos.title: The First and the Last
videos.overview: The Shaman Fight between Team Funbari Hot Springs and Team Ren begins! But before Yoh can launch his counterattack, the match takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: True Justice
videos.overview: Yoh and the others enter the area for the second tournament, but before it can begin, Yoh makes a surprising declaration.

videos.title: Plants
videos.overview: The winner of the Shaman Fight will finally be revealed. Yoh and the others try to stop Hao from joining with the Great Spirit.

videos.title: All the Way
videos.overview: Yoh and the others are giving it their all, but despite their best efforts and sacrifices, Hao manages to reach the King's shrine.

videos.title: Good Night
videos.overview: Yoh and the others arrive at Patch Officiant Kalim's residence, where they decide to take a well-earned rest. But soon, a surprise arrives.

videos.title: Falling Damko
videos.overview: During the battle against Kalim, the darkness that has been burdening Horohoro finally comes to light.

videos.title: Last Test: Shaman Fight
videos.overview: The group finally makes it to the final plant where they face Rutherfor, their most formidable opponent yet.

videos.title: Shaman King: God End
videos.overview: Hao releases the might of his newly acquired powers against Yoh and the others, but the scrappy crew refuses to give up hope.
